title: A charge-dependent electron emission yield from electron irradiated dielectrics
byline: Belhaj; De Almeida; A M Cavalca; Fil; N
html:
Abstract:The total electron emission yield (TEEY) of dielectric surfaces may vary during electron irradiation owing to charge accumulation within the material. In the present work, the generation, transport, and escape formulation of Dionne is extended by introducing an additional attenuation of secondary electrons that depends on trapped positive charge. The resulting emission law is coupled to a charge-balance equation, allowing the TEEY to be calculated as a function of incident energy and injected charge. The model is examined using measurements on polycrystalline Al2O3, from which effective cross sections describing interactions between trapped charge and secondary electrons are determined. Their mean value is then used to predict the evolution of the TEEY curves without further adjustment. Finally, an analytical approximation of the nonlinear charging law is derived to facilitate the implementation in electron-irradiation simulations.
